role: XCTest suite for RawRRBackup and its RawBackupSealer, each test in a folder of its own: backup/retrieve, archive marking, incremental-backup throttling, unarchived counts, purge, CSV export, hash determinism, index-window queries, allBackups ordering, entry duration/size, the never-replace-a-larger-backup and capture-date rules, re-encryption of one-shot files and streamed plain lines, verified discard, the index reconcile and the non-truncating first append.
state: directory: per-test folder <tmp>/RawRRBackupTests-<uuid>, removed in tearDownWithError
backup: lazy RawRRBackup(directory:) over that folder
toplevel: Each test gets a RawRRBackup in a fresh temporary folder of its own (lazy; setUp builds it and waits for the reconcile and repair its init queues), so backups other tests leave in the shared folder are never listed; tearDownWithError removes the folder. An extension of the class holds the streamed-plaintext, reconcile and first-append tests.

units.does: setUp: builds the test's store in its own folder and waits for the reconcile and repair its init queued (waitForQueuedWork), so neither writes into the folder during the test.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test

units.does: Removes the test's backup folder when it exists, then calls super; a removal that throws fails the test.
units.entry: XCTest after each test
